  det   cut (g1): C = 3   (3 iters = 36 layers)  [no variance floor -> tight bound]

legend:
  lam            global noise scale (0 = noiseless, 1 = calibrated device, 2/4 = noisier)
  depth/iter     B = 12 gate-layers per loop body (the pass's knit.body_layers)
  number_of_iterations  realized trip count per shot = the carried qubit's RUNTIME coherent
                 depth in loop iterations (unbounded arm); min_iters / mean_iters / max_iters over shots
  runtime_depth  mean_iters x depth/iter, the mean runtime coherent depth in gate-layers
  bounded_depth  C x B = 36 layers -- the compile-time depth cap the knit cut guarantees
  fidelity       delivered-state Bloch fidelity vs the ideal state (higher = better),
                 shown mean +/- seed-std over seeds
  arms           unbounded = no cutting (control);  knit-quasi(g4) = general gamma^2=16 cut;
                 knit-det(g1) = deterministic gamma=1 cut (proven known state, zero-variance)
